purpose: Candidate retrieval, scoped feature lookup, and concept-graph membership. LLM review decides identity and applicability.

Strong Taylor-stationarity tolerances at the respective orders; tracked independently. The analytic form of the unknown f or c is not revealed to the algorithm.
